payload.title: main-tree edit lost to a reset
payload.body: While undoing its own commit on main, closed-pipe-convicts ran git reset --hard in the main tree and discarded an uncommitted edit to packages/forge/src/cli/commands/install.ts (not its own; probably InstallCorpusPath's, made in main instead of its worktree). The owner has been messaged to redo it in the unit worktree. The first landing 665e4cd1 on the ledger is a main-line commit that no longer exists on main; the second landing 4c24abc4 is the real one.
